notes.title: 🎉 Super Stream-Bara is LIVE! 🎉
notes.content: [h2]Game is available globally for everyone. Thank you all for supporting us so this day could happen! [/h2][p][/p][h2]Have fun![/h2]

notes.title: 🎉 Super Stream-Bara launches on September 15th 17:00 CET! 🎉
notes.content: [h1]Global release on Steam is here! [/h1][p][/p][p]To celebrate, the game will launch with a special discount. We’ve made the adventure a bit shorter than we have planned, and adjusted the price so it perfectly matches the content — delivering the best Stream-Bara experience at a fair value. [/p][p][/p][h3]But that's not all! To celebrate the release, we’re hosting the very first Speedrun Tournament! [/h3][p][/p][p][b]When: 15.09.2025, 20:00 CET → 21.09.2025, 20:00 CET[/b]  [/p][p] Challenge: Beat Chapter 2 as fast as you can! Unlimited attempts within the event time. [/p][p][/p][p] [b]Prizes:[/b] [/p][olist][*][p] Custom Stream-Bara skin (your design!) + CAPPA T-shirt [/p][/*][*][p] CAPPA T-shirt [/p][/*][*][p] CAPPA cap  [/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]To join the tournament, and to see more details about it,  sign up here: [/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/t15cZuwugpCySDri6"]https://forms.gle/t15cZuwugpCySDri6[/url]  [/p][p][/p][h3]Have fun![/h3]

notes.title: 🎉 Super Stream-Bara: Demo Update – Next Fest Developer Showcase! 🎉
notes.content:
[h3]This time, things are getting [i]extra crunchy[/i] with a brand-new demo update debuting just in time for Steam Next Fest.[/h3][h1]
[b]What’s New in the Demo?[/b][/h1][list][*][p][i]Story and NPCs have been reworked. Be sure to check out every secret![/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Emotes! Player can now send emotes to each other![/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Private rooms. You can now create and join private games. Perfect for a playthrough with friends or... a stream with your favourite creator![/i][/p][/*][*][p]Voting effects rebalanced. Those should be more impactful now.[/p][/*][*][p]Bunch of small fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Don’t miss your chance to dive snout-first into the weirdest streamer adventure of the year.[/h3]

notes.title: Super Stream-Bara Demo Update - version 0.04
notes.content:
[h2]Version 0.04 Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Demo split into two parts: Chapter 1 & Nightmare (Nightmare offers harder levels),
[*] Story rework (new npc - evil ghost!),
[*] New feature: Emotes! Players can now send each other emojis,
[*] Voting effects balanced so they appear less, but are more impactful,
[*] New voting animation that show exactly who's voting on what effect,
[*] Private rooms,
[*] Game UI reworked,
[*] Various bugfixes and improvements
[/list]
